shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rough stone surface
horizontal band/register of small repeated motifs
broadly rectangular carved panel as the main field
small animal-like or figural signs (in A, indistinct; in B, explicit)
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on a rectangular stone face organised, at least in part, into horizontal registers of repeated small motifs, and both include small figural/animal-like signs. The decisive difference is scale and density: A is an even, allover carpet of tiny uniform signs covering the whole slab with no dominant figure, while B is dominated by a few large, individually modelled animals (quadruped, bird, elongated creature) set against blank ground beneath a single ornamental band, on a three-dimensional shaped block rather than a flat panel.
